The dog on the left is partially visible, mostly showing its rear and side, also with similar coloring. The background consists of tree bark, roots, and scattered dry leaves.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dog on the right exhibits a compact, sturdy build with a relatively short back, fitting the 'cobby' description typical of toy spaniels.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The front legs of the right-hand dog appear straight and slender (fine bone). Feathering is visible on the upper parts of the legs.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail of the primary subject (right dog) is obscured by the angle and the other dog. The tail of the left dog is not clearly visible or distinguishable from the background clutter.
